traditional: No classical doctrine: Uranus, Pluto is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Disruption meets power. Upheaval and radical transformation, often tied to social change; quick adaptation to new technology. Psychologically the square is inner tension to integrate: Destructive upheaval and the urge to overturn at speed. The growth is owning both sides instead of splitting them.

cyclic.waxing: Crisis of action: take conscious hold and build a durable form for disruption against power, or be thrown off course.
cyclic.waning: Crisis of meaning: break down the disruption/power form that has outlived its purpose and reorient toward the next cycle.

business: Friction in this area. Transformative, disruptive, generational themes.
shadow: Instability for its own sake collides with control and obsession; forcing or splitting it instead of working it through.
arcApplying: Friction builds toward a forced adjustment.
arcSeparating: The crisis passes; what was restructured settles.

readerCopy.summary: Breaking one restriction can feel like freedom right up until you realize the new arrangement gives somebody else the power to change the terms.
readerCopy.body: Breaking one restriction can feel like freedom right up until you realize the new arrangement gives somebody else the power to change the terms. When Uranus squares Pluto, disruption can open access while simultaneously creating a new struggle over who owns, controls, or benefits from what replaces the old system. Do not confuse novelty with independence. Before you hand the new option your money, information, loyalty, or trust, make sure you understand who can still close the door once you are inside.
